author: Poag
description: Logs who's in voice channels in a server and how long each session lasts. Sessions are logged as plain start/end intervals per user per channel; this cog doesn't compute who was in voice together itself - that, and cross-referencing with the gamelog cog's game activity, is meant to be derived later as the basis for a relationship graph. Requires the Voice States intent to be enabled for the bot.
install_msg: Thanks for installing VoiceLog! This cog requires the Voice States intent to be enabled for the bot in order to see voice channel activity - see the repo README for details.
short: Logs per-session voice channel activity for members.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per server: a Discord user ID, a voice channel ID, and the start time, end time, and duration of each voice session. This is used to answer in-server voice-time queries via this cog's commands, and may be used to derive relationship data (who was in voice together, cross-referenced with the gamelog cog) in the future. All stored data for a user is deleted when Red processes a data deletion request for that user.
